body:
Still an issue / angular 5.2.3.

In angular.js [the router parses the uri component in a try/catch](https://github.com/angular/angular.js/blob/e3ece2fad9e1e6d47b5f06815ff186d7e6f44948/src/Angular.js#L1395-L1433), thus ignoring invalid parts of the URL.

[angular 5 doesn't try/catch](https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/c8a1a14b87e5907458e8e87021e47f9796cb3257/packages/router/src/url_tree.ts#L348-L350). If decodeURIComponent throws (just like `decodeURIComponent('%')` does), then the app stops functioning.
I'm working on the solution and will submit the PR in near future.

issue.title: feat(router): add ability to recover from malformed url

## What is the current behavior?

<!-- Please describe the current behavior that you are modifying, or link to a relevant issue. -->

Using invalid character sequences (like %) in the query param throws an exception that can't be catched anywhere and causing the app to crash.

Issue Number: [21468](https://github.com/angular/angular/issues/21468)

## What is the new behavior?
Code that might throw an exception is wrapped inside the `try/catch` construction preventing app from crash.
